description: An oscillator with four unusual waveforms, each from a different formula, growing richer in harmonics from the first to the fourth

params.text: Sets the pitch in whole octaves, three either side of C4

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, an octave per volt, added to the OCTAVE knob and held within four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz

outputs.text: A cosine of e raised to a sine, which is a rounded wave with a dip in each peak
A sine whose amplitude grows across the cycle and is then clipped flat, so it is loud and lopsided
A cosine of the hyperbolic cosine of e raised to a sine, which is the busiest of the smooth waves
An eight-step staircase of random levels, its first half inverted, fixed when the module is made and unchanged after that

notes: the four waves run from one phase, so they are all at the same pitch and locked together.
the staircase output has a DC offset unless its eight random levels happen to average zero.
the random staircase is drawn once when the module is made, so a fresh copy of the module gives a different wave and a saved patch does not bring the old one back.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
